description: Repository Reachable from Outside a VPC Endpoint
rationale: ECR has no network-level access control of its own: its endpoint is public and any principal holding valid credentials can pull from it, or push to it, from anywhere on the Internet, so a leaked deployment key is immediately usable from outside the account's network. Interface VPC endpoints only add a private route, they take nothing away from the public one. Combining them with a repository policy conditioned on aws:SourceVpce is the only way to require that requests arrive through the VPC, which is what makes stolen credentials alone insufficient to read the images or to replace them.
remediation: Create interface VPC endpoints for ECR in the VPCs that use the repository, then add a statement to the repository policy denying every request whose aws:SourceVpce is not one of them
